punchline: In 1940 a calorie of fossil fuel yielded 2.3 calories of food; today a calorie of supermarket food takes 10 of fossil fuel.
thirty_sec: In 1909 Fritz Haber made ammonia from air, drop by drop. BASF's Carl Bosch scaled it into a factory process, which first fed explosives in wartime and later, according to Michael Pollan, fertilizer on American fields. Corn demands more nitrogen fertilizer than any other crop. In 1940 each fossil-fuel calorie produced 2.3 food calories; now a calorie of supermarket food takes 10 of fossil fuel.
